How I can help

Care for what you're carrying

Evidence-based therapy, including CBT and motivational interviewing, shaped around your goals and your culture.

Anxiety

Worry, racing thoughts and tension that get in the way of daily life.

Depression

Low mood, loss of interest and feeling stuck, with steady support to move forward.

Substance use

Support for changing your relationship with alcohol or drugs, at your pace.

Bipolar disorder

Tools to understand mood shifts, build routines and stay steady.

OCD

Practical, evidence-based strategies for intrusive thoughts and compulsions.

Stress

Work, family and life transitions, with space to breathe and regroup.

Getting started

Three simple steps

  1. Send a requestShare your name, contact details and the best time to reach you. No health questions online.
  2. Chantal reaches outWithin one business day, to answer your questions and confirm your insurance or self-pay.
  3. Meet by secure videoYour first session happens online, from anywhere in New York State that feels private to you.
Who I work with

Teens and adults, in the language you're most at home in

I work with adults and with teens ages 13 to 17. Parents and guardians can request an appointment for their teen. I do not offer couples counseling.
